recording_in_progress: Recording in progress ({elapsed}), click to go to recording page
abandon_desc: The recording will be terminated and all data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
engine_badge_tip_local: Offline mode: transcription, voiceprint and summaries run entirely on-device or via your local endpoint. Data never leaves your device. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_proxy: Trial quota: cloud ASR and LLM are reached through the platform's shared proxy, consuming trial minutes. Business data is never persisted on project servers. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_selfkey: Own Key: connects directly to the cloud ASR / LLM services you configured, billed by your provider. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_unready: Offline not ready: offline mode is selected but local components or models are missing; transcription tasks will be suspended. Click to open settings
engine_badge_aria: Access status: {state}. Click to view data flows
